required_behavior: A cross-profile worker child that explicitly requests workspace_kind=worktree inherits its worker task's canonical Project, receives a distinct project worktree and branch, and rejects a conflicting explicit Project. A terminal-affinity Supervisor card that shares its root worktree as workspace_kind=dir is also a canonical Project source only when its worktree leaf identifies that same root. A current-board Project/affinity root whose shared worktree was created for a prior board also keeps its Project when the leaf names no task in this board: recovery requires the exact source Project and affinity, exact board metadata binding the same Project to the repository containing the shared path, and exactly one opaque leaf under <board default_workdir>/.worktrees/, while every board/path/Project/affinity mismatch fails closed before an invalid child is persisted.

evidence.result: The integrated ancestor commit provides cross-profile routing from a canonical source task when a Project has already been inherited.

The target inherits a worker Project only when workspace_kind is omitted, so an explicit worktree request bypasses inheritance and conflict rejection; it has no affinity-terminal workspace_kind=dir source variant.
The open PR changes inheritance to depend only on an omitted workspace path and rejects a conflicting explicit Project.

retirement_gate.summary: With an empty worker Projects registry, verify both a direct worktree source and an affinity-terminal dir source preserve the canonical Project, materialize a real distinct worktree and branch, reject a conflicting Project, and reject a noncanonical dir source; then verify that a current-board Project/affinity root sharing a prior-board worktree leaf still recovers the board-bound Project/repository identity in the new terminal and its cross-profile worktree child, while every board/path/Project/affinity mismatch fails before invalid persistence.

evidence.result: The omitted-workspace control inherited the Project and received a fresh workspace, but an explicit worktree child did not inherit or get a fresh project workspace and a conflicting Project was not rejected. The exact revision also has no affinity-terminal dir source variant.
Commit b9b5481d6236edb3ec8aae32cc4b5c661569b872 covers source-task routing; open PR 89363 contains the still-missing explicit-worktree inheritance and conflict check.
